exposure: Women who underwent lumbar transforaminal epidural steroid injection
Women who underwent cervical interlaminar epidural steroid injection
Women who underwent lumbar interlaminar epidural steroid injection
Women who underwent caudal epidural steroid injection
cohort: 78 women who had epidural steroid injections between the ages of 18 and 55 years
finding: This study suggests that epidural steroid injections are associated with changes in the menstrual cycle, with obesity being a significant risk factor.
